job_spec.purpose: q13-coll root cause of wt1 PPL-0111: the E face carries 2,816 pins (10x128 relay/held/out + sr/sx 2x384 + 6x128 queue heads) but 237.6 um of M4 at the 2-track pin pitch (0.096) holds 2,460 slots. Physical fix without an M6 grant and without area growth: re-shape the pin-bound leaf to 259.2 x 291.6 um (75,583 um2 vs 76,982): E face 3022 slots >= 2,816, W face 1,792 pins; same RTL (c6a0c7392 leaf, exact 9 / prod 3 / owner mutant), same registered edges, 0 cycles. Also carries the macro pin-edge M5 access guard (9 SRAMs; col_tile ct1-ct5 root cause). Variant a. | wt3a: wt2a FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance (u_tq k0 175.8 um, u_lq k1 102.9 um from their W-face write pins): the four FIFO macros whose wd_in is wired straight from W pins (eq, lq k0/k1, tq) are bound to the W column (x 31.968, centre 57.7 um from the face) in pin order, and eq_wd/lq_wd/tq_wd get 30-um pin ranges opposite their macro rows; lb/pq/rq (written from internal registers) take the centre/E columns. Same RTL, same cycles, every stage <= ~75 um pin-to-macro.
